description_en: Creates a trigger to start data processing in Intelligent Media Management (IMM). The trigger is activated by event sources, such as Object Storage Service (OSS), and uses data processing templates to process media files, such as images, videos, and documents
description_zh: 创建触发器任务，可通过OSS等事件源触发IMM数据处理，支持选择多种数据处理模板，对图片、视频、文档等媒体文件执行相应的处理
kebab_example: aliyun imm create-trigger --project-name test-project --input example-string --actions '[{"Parameters":["pages=3"],"FastFailPolicy":"example-string","Name":"doc/convert"}]' --notification '{"MNS":"example-string"}' --tags key=val --service-role AliyunIMMBatchTriggerRole --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateTrigger

parameters.description_en:
The service role that grants Intelligent Media Management (IMM) permissions to access other cloud resources, such as Object Storage Service (OSS). The default value is AliyunIMMBatchTriggerRole.

To use a custom service role, create a service role and grant permissions to the role in the Resource Access Management (RAM) console. For more information, see [Create a service role](~~116800~~) and [Grant permissions to a RAM role](~~116147~~).
parameters.description_zh:
服务角色，授权给IMM服务以访问其他云资源（例如OSS）的权限，默认值为AliyunIMMBatchTriggerRole。

如果要自定义服务角色，您可以通过RAM控制台创建普通服务角色并为角色授权。具体操作，请分别参见[创建普通服务角色](~~116800~~)和[为角色授权](~~116147~~)。
